draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.54, the 258th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 14th of 14 at QB. He went 149th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (258th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 2,822 passing yards in 2022, 12th of 14 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Cincinnati Bengals (practice squad). 2 career games and 0 starts over 1 completed season. Still developing: 0 AV in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (1st percentile). Played 2 of 17 games in 2023. Versus the typical Year-1 quarterback who played: 37 passing yards against a median of 1,341, below the norm.
